The '''Rq9.Z flight control avionics''' package was the control system for the fast, maneuverable [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]], and was manufactured by [[Torplex/Legends|Torplex]].
